steps.text: Stand behind a chair and hold the back of it.
Rise onto your toes, keeping your knees straight.
Lower your heels slowly to the floor.

safety: Keep holding the chair the whole time.

mistakes.label: low_raise
mistakes.wrong: your heels did not rise high enough
mistakes.right: Rise a little higher onto your toes, holding the chair, only as far as feels steady.

mistakes.label: leaning_forward
mistakes.wrong: you leaned your upper body forwards
mistakes.right: Rise straight up, keeping a light hold on the chair rather than leaning on it.

setup: Stand behind a chair, side-on to the phone.
